about: AI pickability panel for AmIMotion. 30 unbranded buyer questions (does an engine name AmIMotion?) and 10 branded questions (does it describe AmIMotion correctly?). Source: website/discoverability/02_Keyword_and_Question_Map.md section 6, extended 28 Oct 2026. 'facts' are the ideas a correct, citable answer has to carry; each entry is a regex and one match counts. 'page' is the canonical page that should answer it. M-questions are the exact buyer questions from the 26 Oct Machine Read (Gemini, 10 runs each): AmIMotion was named in 4 of 60 India/US answers, 0 of 30 in the US, 0 of 29 from memory. Customer, prospect and partner names to block live in tools/private_names.txt (one regex per line, kept out of git).
